Expected I/O worked out from OpenRGB's C++ (commit d4798c120659ec5ba2e664a9e87bedff8d36f880, Controllers/CoolerMasterController/CMKeyboardController and KeyboardLayoutManager) by a separate Python model that mirrors SendCommand, _GetFirmwareVersion, GetKeyboardLayout, SetLEDControl, SetLeds and the KeyboardLayoutManager key rules (openrgb-work/batch2/coolermaster/gen_masterkeys.py and klm.py in the porting session's scratch space, not part of the repository); plugin.js was never run to make them. Each variant is one key table (PRO_S = mk_pro_s_layout, PRO_L = mk_pro_l_layout) in one regional layout, chosen by the firmware string the keyboard reports (first character 1 = ANSI, 2 = ISO, 3 = JIS); firmware_reply is the answer to 01 02 without the report id. ops: write = output report (65 bytes, report id 0x00 first), read = input report read (hid_read; HueDeck waits at most 50 ms). Initialize = the firmware query OpenRGB's constructor sends; frames = SetLeds (enter manual mode, then 8 x 16 colours); shutdown = HueDeck's hand-back to the keyboard's own lighting (41 00, MODE_FIRMWARE).
